questions.question: Cobras set a database record (24/25 season, T20) with a value of 198. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Cobras.

questions.question: Excluding Western Province, which team has won the most domestic titles in this database?
questions.explanation: Dragons have won 4 titles, the most of any union other than the dominant Western Province.

questions.question: At Buffalo Park, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Who holds the record for 'Most Fours' in the 17/18 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Stacey Lackay holds it, with a total of 27.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)' in the 19/20 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 40.

questions.question: At which ground did Nadine de Klerk record their career-best innings (74, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Newlands Stadium, against Dolphins on 2025/03/23.
